A '''linguibox''' was a [[translator unit]]. The [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Ratoog]] wore a linguibox on his [[Belt/Legends|belt]] to translate his native [[Gamorrese]] to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].
